To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Mn/Ti-Snx (x = 0, 2, 4, 8) catalysts were synthesized, characterized by various methods and their catalytic performances for low-temperature SCR reaction were investigated comparatively.

the Mn/Ti-Zn catalyst exhibited better catalytic activity and SO2 tolerance at low temperature than the Mn/Ti-Al catalyst, but the Mn/Ti-Ag catalyst exhibited better catalysis and SO2 tolerance than the Mn/TiT-Zn catalyst.
the Mn/Ti-Ox catalyst with Ti-Sn solid solutions as a carrier has the best performance and the best resistance to SO2 poisoning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a series of Mn/Ti-M (M = Sn, Z, Al) Ox catalyst for NH3-SCRs at low temperature.
a novel method of preparing catalysts with high catalytic activity for low-temperature NH3-SCR of NOx, which could provide some guidance for the development of low-temperature NH4+SCR catalysts.
the effect of different metal oxides on the catalytic performance of Mn/TiOx catalysts for low-temperature SCR of NOx with NH3 in presence of SO2.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Mn/Ti-Ox catalysts were highly active and selective for NOx reduction at low temperature, and the Mn/Ti-Zn sample had better resistance to SO2.
the Mn/Ti-Zn catalyst had the best low-temperature SCR performance and the Mn/Ti-Al catalyst had the worst low-temperature SCR activity, and the Mn/Tio-Sn catalyst had the highest SO2 resistance.
Mn/Ti-Snanalysis showed better activity and SO2 resistance at low temperature than Mn/Ti-Zranalysis, but worse than Mn/Ti-Alanalysis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Mn/Ti-Ox catalysts with different M (M = Sn, Zrn, Al) were prepared by the traditional impregnation method.
Mn/Ti-Sm was the best catalyst for low-temperature SCR reaction, but all the catalysts were poisoned by SO2 and the poisoning effect of SO2 was more severe with the Mn/Tio-Al sample.
Mn/Ti-Si was more suitable for NH3- SCR reaction at low temperature.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Mn/Ti-Snx (x = 0.1) is a promising catalyst for low-temperature NH3-SCR.
Mn/Ti-Snx catalysts are more active than Mn/Ti-Zrx and Mn/Ti-Alx catalysts for low-temperature SCR reaction.
Ti-Sn support is the most suitable carrier for MnOx to improve its activity for low temperature NH3-SCR.
